verses.sloka: आर्तानां राक्षसीनां तु लङ्कायां वै कुले कुले।रावणः करुणं शब्दं शुश्राव परिदेवितम् ।। ६.९६.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ārtānāṁ rākṣasīnāṁ tu laṅkāyāṁ vai kule kule।rāvaṇaḥ karuṇaṁ śabdaṁ śuśrāva paridevitam ।। 6.96.1 ।।

translations.english: Ravana heard from every house in Lanka sounds of piteous cries and pathetic sounds of the afflicted.

verses.sloka: स तु दीर्घं विनिश्वस्य मुहूर्तं ध्यानमास्थितः।बभूव परमक्रुद्धो रावणो भीमदर्शनः ।। ६.९६.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu dīrghaṁ viniśvasya muhūrtaṁ dhyānamāsthitaḥ।babhūva paramakruddho rāvaṇo bhīmadarśanaḥ ।। 6.96.2 ।।

translations.english: Ravana remained silent for long, thought for a moment and assumed a terrific angry form.
translations.hindi: बन में युद्ध करते हुए, दो श्रेष्ठ हाथियों की तर 9 र ह्‌ वे दो घदुघ- धारियों में श्रेष्ठ योद्धा, एक दूसरे का संहार करने के स्यसे एक दूसरे प्र बाशो की वर्षा कर रहेथे

verses.sloka: सन्दश्य दशनैरोष्ठं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः।राक्षसैरपि दुर्दर्शः कालाग्निरिव मूर्च्छितः ।। ६.९६.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sandaśya daśanairoṣṭhaṁ krodhasaṁraktalocanaḥ।rākṣasairapi durdarśaḥ kālāgniriva mūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.96.3 ।।

translations.english: Biting his teeth, eyes turned red in wrath, Ravana was perplexed. He was difficult to look at even for the Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: उवाच च समीपस्थान् राक्षसान् राक्षसेश्वरः।भयाव्यक्तकथस्तत्र निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा ।। ६.९६.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca samīpasthān rākṣasān rākṣaseśvaraḥ।bhayāvyaktakathastatra nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā ।। 6.96.4 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke the Lord of Rakshasas indistinctly in anger with his eyes burning as though it would consume them (Rakshasas). He commanded Mahodara, Mahaparsva and Virupaksha who stood nearby saying" quickly instruct the army to go."

verses.sloka: महोदरमाहपार्श्वौ विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम्।शीघ्रं वदत सैन्यानि निर्यातेति ममाज्ञया ।। ६.९६.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahodaramāhapārśvau virūpākṣaṁ ca rākṣasam।śīghraṁ vadata sainyāni niryāteti mamājñayā ।। 6.96.5 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke the Lord of Rakshasas indistinctly in anger with his eyes burning as though it would consume them (Rakshasas). He commanded Mahodara, Mahaparsva and Virupaksha who stood nearby saying" quickly instruct the army to go."

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते भयार्दिताः।चोदयामासुरव्यग्रान् राक्षसांस्तान् नृपाज्ञया ।। ६.९६.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rākṣasāste bhayārditāḥ।codayāmāsuravyagrān rākṣasāṁstān nṛpājñayā ।। 6.96.6 ।।

translations.english: On hearing the words of the king's order, the Rakshasas stricken with fear, unagitated, started thinking.
translations.hindi: अतः वानरों को धोखा देने के लिए आप लोग ढिठाई के साथ अर्थात्‌ दृढ़तापूवक लड़े। मैं दूसरे रथ में बैठ कर, अभीं समरभूमि में लोट कर आता हूँ

verses.sloka: ते तु सर्वे तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः।कृतस्वस्त्ययनाः सर्वे रणायाभिमुखा ययुः ।। ६.९६.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tu sarve tathetyuktvā rākṣasā ghoradarśanāḥ।kṛtasvastyayanāḥ sarve raṇāyābhimukhā yayuḥ ।। 6.96.7 ।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas with frightful looks saying 'Be it so', having prepared themselves with armor went towards the battlefield.

verses.sloka: प्रतिपूज्य यथान्यायं रावणं ते निशाचराः।तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे भर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ६.९६.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: pratipūjya yathānyāyaṁ rāvaṇaṁ te niśācarāḥ।tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve bharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.96.8 ।।

translations.english: All the great chariot warrior spraying to Ravana with folded palms stood desiring success.
translations.hindi: स्ठुवानः=स्तुवन्‌ । श्राषः शानच्‌. | ( गो० ) ६८२ युद्धकाण्डे यह्‌ कह कर और वानरों को धोखा देकर, शत्रुहन्ता इन्द्रजीत दूसरा रथ लेने के लिए लङ्कापुरी में चला गया

verses.sloka: अथोवाच प्रहस्यैतान् रावणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः।महोदरमहापार्श्वौ विरूपाक्षं च राक्षसम् ।। ६.९६.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: athovāca prahasyaitān rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ।mahodaramahāpārśvau virūpākṣaṁ ca rākṣasam ।। 6.96.9 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana who was deluded with anger, laughing aloud spoke to Mahodara, Mahaparsva and Virupaksha.

verses.sloka: अद्य बाणैर्धनुर्मुक्तैर्युगान्तादित्यसन्निभैः।राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव नेष्यामि यमसादनम् ।। ६.९६.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: adya bāṇairdhanurmuktairyugāntādityasannibhaiḥ।rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva neṣyāmi yamasādanam ।। 6.96.10 ।।

translations.english: Loosening the shafts from the bow, Ravana resembling the Sun at the time of dissolution of the universe said," I shall dispatch Raghava and Lakshmana to the abode of the Lord of death."
translations.hindi: उस रथ का चलाने वाला जो सारथौ था बह घोड़ों क मन की बात जानने वाला एवं भली सलाह बतलाने वाला था | समर- बिजयी महातेजस्वी इन्द्रजीत उस रथ पर सवार हुआ

verses.sloka: खरस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य प्रहस्तेन्द्रजितोस्तथा।करिष्यामि प्रतीकारमद्य शत्रुवधादहम् ।। ६.९६.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: kharasya kumbhakarṇasya prahastendrajitostathā।kariṣyāmi pratīkāramadya śatruvadhādaham ।। 6.96.11 ।।

translations.english: "Today by the killing the enemy I will take my revenge and also of Khara, Kumbhakarna, Prahastha and Indrajith."
translations.hindi: इस बार मन्दोदरीपुत्र इन्द्रजीत के साथ प्रधान प्रधान राक्षस और हो लिये। मौत का भेजा हुआ इन्द्रजीत फिर तुरन्त ही नगरी के बाहिर निकला

verses.sloka: नैवान्तरिक्षं न दिशो न नद्यो नापि सागराः।प्रकाशत्वं गमिष्यन्ति मद्बाणजलदावृताः ।। ६.९६.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: naivāntarikṣaṁ na diśo na nadyo nāpi sāgarāḥ।prakāśatvaṁ gamiṣyanti madbāṇajaladāvṛtāḥ ।। 6.96.12 ।।

translations.english: "By my arrows covering the sky like clouds there will be no effulgence both in space and in the quarters and not even in the ocean."
translations.hindi: न प्ररवइदवश न। ( रा) २ आतो हि ( रा० ) २ श्राप्तोंपदेशि 2.5 ना--हितमफ ब्टुंशीलमस्त्यस्यतेन ( रा» ) । क एकनवतितमः सग: ६८३: शत्रुहन्ता इन्द्रजीत नगरी के बाहिर पहुँच, बड़ी तेजी से चलने वाले घोड़ों को हँकवा वहाँ गया ; जहाँ विभीषण सहित लक्ष्मण जी थे

verses.sloka: अद्य वानरमुख्यानां तानि यूथानि भागशः।धनुषा शरजालेन विधमिष्यामि पत्रिणा ।। ६.९६.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya vānaramukhyānāṁ tāni yūthāni bhāgaśaḥ।dhanuṣā śarajālena vidhamiṣyāmi patriṇā ।। 6.96.13 ।।

translations.english: "Today by the network of plumed arrows released from my bow I shall kill the troops of Vanara leaders' part by part."
translations.hindi: तब लक्ष्मण, विभीषण तथा अन्य वानरगण इन्द्रजीत को दूसरे रथ में बैठा हुआ देख,

verses.sloka: अद्य वानरसैन्यानि रथेन पवनौजसा।धनुःसमुद्रादुद्भूतैर्मथिष्यामि शरोर्मिभिः ।। ६.९६.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya vānarasainyāni rathena pavanaujasā।dhanuḥsamudrādudbhūtairmathiṣyāmi śarormibhiḥ ।। 6.96.14 ।।

translations.english: "Seated on the chariot I shall knock out the Vanara army by the waves in the form of arrows released from the ocean of my bow."
translations.hindi: उन बुद्धिमान इन्द्रजोत को फुर्ती पर बड़े विस्मित हुए । अब तो इन्द्रजीत क्रोध में भर युद्ध करता हुआ सैकड़ों सहस्रों बानरयूथपतियों को बाण मार कर गिराने लगा । समरविज्ञयी इन्द्रजीत ऐसी फुर्ती से लड़ रहा था कि, उसका धनुष सदा मण्डलाकार ही देख पड़ता था

verses.sloka: आकोशपद्मवक्त्राणि पद्मकेसरवर्चसाम्।अद्य यूथतटाकानि गजवत् प्रमथाम्यहम् ।। ६.९६.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: ākośapadmavaktrāṇi padmakesaravarcasām।adya yūthataṭākāni gajavat pramathāmyaham ।। 6.96.15 ।।

translations.english: "Like an elephant now I shall torment the ponds in the form of battalions of Vanaras shining like the filaments of lotuses, with their faces resembling open lotuses."

verses.sloka: सशरैरद्य वदनैः सङ्ख्ये वानरयूथपाः।मण्डयिष्यन्ति वसुधां सनालैरिव पङ्कजैः ।। ६.९६.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: saśarairadya vadanaiḥ saṅkhye vānarayūthapāḥ।maṇḍayiṣyanti vasudhāṁ sanālairiva paṅkajaiḥ ।। 6.96.16 ।।

translations.english: "Now with the arrows fixed on their faces the Vanara battalions spread on the earth will adorn the earth like lotuses spread on earth."
translations.hindi: बह्‌ क्रोध में भर बड़ी फुर्ती के साथ वानरों को मार रहा था । उस भीमविक्रमी इन्द्रजीत के नाराचा से मारे जाने पर,. वानरगण

verses.sloka: अद्य युद्धप्रचण्डानां हरीणां द्रुमयोधिनाम्।मुक्तेनैकेषुणा युद्धे भेत्स्यामि च शतं शतम् ।। ६.९६.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya yuddhapracaṇḍānāṁ harīṇāṁ drumayodhinām।muktenaikeṣuṇā yuddhe bhetsyāmi ca śataṁ śatam ।। 6.96.17 ।।

translations.english: "Today in the combat each one of the arrows released by me will pierce through one hundred monkeys vehemently fighting with trees"
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे लक्ष्मण जी के शरण में बैसे ही गए ; जैसे प्रजागण, प्रजा- पति ( ब्रह्मा | के शरण में जाते हैं । तब तो समरकोप से प्रज्ब- लित हो लक्ष्मण जी ने

verses.sloka: हतो भर्ता हतो भ्राता यासां च तनया हताः।वधेनाद्य रिपोस्तासां करोम्यस्रप्रमार्जनम् ।। ६.९६.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: hato bhartā hato bhrātā yāsāṁ ca tanayā hatāḥ।vadhenādya ripostāsāṁ karomyasrapramārjanam ।। 6.96.18 ।।

translations.english: "Today through the destruction of the enemy I will wipe the tears of the one whose son has been killed, whose brother has been killed."
translations.hindi: अपने हाथ की सफाई दिखलाते हुए , इन्द्रजीत का धनुष काट डाला । इन्द्रजीत ने दूसरा धनुष लिया और बहुत जल्दी से उस पर रोदा चढ़ाया

verses.sloka: अद्य मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नैः प्रकीर्णैर्गतचेतनैः।करोमि वानरैर्युद्धे यत्नावेक्ष्यतलां महीम् ।। ६.९६.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: adya madbāṇanirbhinnaiḥ prakīrṇairgatacetanaiḥ।karomi vānarairyuddhe yatnāvekṣyatalāṁ mahīm ।। 6.96.19 ।।

translations.english: "Today, in the combat, my arrows will split open the Vanaras and ceased of life, they will be covering the earth. It will be possible to see the ground only with effort."

verses.sloka: अद्य गोमायवो गृध्रा ये च मांसाशिनो ऽपरे।सर्वांस्तांस्तर्पयिष्यामि शत्रुमांसैः शरार्पितैः ।। ६.९६.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: adya gomāyavo gṛdhrā ye ca māṁsāśino 'pare।sarvāṁstāṁstarpayiṣyāmi śatrumāṁsaiḥ śarārpitaiḥ ।। 6.96.20 ।।

translations.english: "Today I shall provide for whatever animals, eagles or flesheating animals the flesh of enemies killed by my arrows."
translations.hindi: पाँच बाण इन्द्रजीत की छाती में मार कर उसे घायल किआ | लक्ष्मण जी के विशाल धनुष से छूटे हुए वे पांचों बाण मेघनाद के शारीर को फोड़ कर

verses.sloka: कल्प्यतां मे रथः शीघ्रं क्षिप्रमानीयतां धनुः।अनुप्रयान्तु मां सर्वे ये ऽवशिष्टा निशाचराः ।। ६.९६.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: kalpyatāṁ me rathaḥ śīghraṁ kṣipramānīyatāṁ dhanuḥ।anuprayāntu māṁ sarve ye 'vaśiṣṭā niśācarāḥ ।। 6.96.21 ।।

translations.english: "Let my chariot and bow be ready and brought here. Let the night rangers who survived follow me."
translations.hindi: रक्त में सने हुए लाल रंग के सांपों को तरह, प्रथिवी पर जा गिरे । इन्द्रजीत का कवच टूट गया और उसके मख .. निकलने लगा

verses.sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महापार्श्वो ऽब्रवीद्वचः।बलाध्यक्षान् स्थितांस्तत्र बलं सन्त्वर्यतामिति ।। ६.९६.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā mahāpārśvo 'bravīdvacaḥ।balādhyakṣān sthitāṁstatra balaṁ santvaryatāmiti ।। 6.96.22 ।।

translations.english: On hearing the speech of Ravana, Mahaparsva enjoined the mighty leaders of the army standing there and spoke as follows.
translations.hindi: तब उसने बड़ी मजबूत प्रत्यव्वा वाला एक उत्तम धनुष ले, बड़ी सफाइ के साथ लक्ष्मण को निशाना बना

verses.sloka: बलाध्यक्षास्तु संरब्धा राक्षसांस्तान् गृहाद्गृहात्।चोदयन्तः परिययुर्लङ्कायां तु महाबलाः ।। ६.९६.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: balādhyakṣāstu saṁrabdhā rākṣasāṁstān gṛhādgṛhāt।codayantaḥ pariyayurlaṅkāyāṁ tu mahābalāḥ ।। 6.96.23 ।।

translations.english: "Let the army leaders of mighty valour go hurriedly to search in every house in Lanka for Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: ततो मुहूर्तान्निष्पेतू राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः।नर्दन्तो भीमवदना नानाप्रहरणैर्भुजैः ।। ६.९६.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato muhūrtānniṣpetū rākṣasā bhīmadarśanāḥ।nardanto bhīmavadanā nānāpraharaṇairbhujaiḥ ।। 6.96.24 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas of terrific looks, and frightening faces holding on shoulders roaring departed with swords, spears, tridents, maces, iron bars, halas, sharp pointed javelins, huge Kutamudgaras, staffs and several discusses, sharp Bhindipalas, Sataghnis and many kinds of excellent weapons.
translations.hindi: उनके ऊपर वैसे ही बाणवृष्टि की जैसे इन्द्र जलवृष्टि करते हैं । न्द्रजीत के छोड़े बाणों का बृष्टि को, जिसे कोई दूसरा नहीं रोक सकता था, शात्रहन्ता लक्ष्मण जी सहज में रोक कर, मेघनाद को अपना पराक्रम दिखला रहे थे ॥२३.

verses.sloka: असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैर्हुलैः।शक्तिभिस्तीक्ष्णधाराभिर्महद्भिः कूटमुद्गरैः ।। ६.९६.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: asibhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlairgadābhirmusalairhulaiḥ।śaktibhistīkṣṇadhārābhirmahadbhiḥ kūṭamudgaraiḥ ।। 6.96.25 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas of terrific looks, and frightening faces holding on shoulders roaring departed with swords, spears, tridents, maces, iron bars, halas, sharp pointed javelins, huge Kutamudgaras, staffs and several discusses, sharp Bhindipalas, Sataghnis and many kinds of excellent weapons.

verses.sloka: यष्टिभिर्विमलैश्चक्रैर्निशितैश्च परश्वधैः।भिण्डिपालैः शतघ्नीभिरन्यैश्चापि वरायुधैः ।। ६.९६.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: yaṣṭibhirvimalaiścakrairniśitaiśca paraśvadhaiḥ।bhiṇḍipālaiḥ śataghnībhiranyaiścāpi varāyudhaiḥ ।। 6.96.26 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas of terrific looks, and frightening faces holding on shoulders roaring departed with swords, spears, tridents, maces, iron bars, halas, sharp pointed javelins, huge Kutamudgaras, staffs and several discusses, sharp Bhindipalas, Sataghnis and many kinds of excellent weapons.

verses.sloka: अथानयद्बलाध्यक्षः सत्वरो रावणाज्ञया।द्रुतं सूतसमायुक्तं युक्ताष्टतुरगं रथम् ।। ६.९६.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: athānayadbalādhyakṣaḥ satvaro rāvaṇājñayā।drutaṁ sūtasamāyuktaṁ yuktāṣṭaturagaṁ ratham ।। 6.96.27 ।।

translations.english: Then by Ravana's command. the chief of the army with chariot rider brought the chariot yoked to eight horses quickly. Then dreadful and selfeffulgent glowing Ravana ascended the chariot."

verses.sloka: आरुरोह रथं भीमो दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ।। ६.९६.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: āruroha rathaṁ bhīmo dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā ।। 6.96.28 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana surrounded by many Rakshasas set out swiftly rending the earth with all his might and majesty.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रयातः सहसा राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः।रावणः सत्त्वगाम्भीर्याद्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.९६.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prayātaḥ sahasā rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ।rāvaṇaḥ sattvagāmbhīryāddārayanniva medinīm ।। 6.96.29 ।।

translations.english: Duly permitted by Ravana, Mahaparsva and Mahodara who are difficult to overpower and also Virupaksha ascended their chariots.

verses.sloka: रावणेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ महापार्श्वमहोदरौ।विरूपाक्षश्च दुर्धर्षो रथानारुरुहुस्तदा ।। ६.९६.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇenābhyanujñātau mahāpārśvamahodarau।virūpākṣaśca durdharṣo rathānāruruhustadā ।। 6.96.30 ।।

translations.english: Happy leaders, roaring exultantly, as if breaking the earth, emerged, turning round, desiring victory and sallied forth.

verses.sloka: ते तु हृष्टा विनर्दन्तो भिन्दन्त इव मेदिनीम्।नादं घोरं विमुञ्जन्तो निर्ययुर्जयकांक्षिणः ।। ६.९६.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: te tu hṛṣṭā vinardanto bhindanta iva medinīm।nādaṁ ghoraṁ vimuñjanto niryayurjayakāṁkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.96.31 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana surrounded by the army of Rakshasas lifted his bow, like the Lord Yama at the time of dissolution of the universe, went for the battle glowing.

verses.sloka: ततो युद्धाय तेजस्वी रक्षोगणबलैर्वृतः।निर्ययावुद्यतधनुः कालान्तकयमोपमः ।। ६.९६.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato yuddhāya tejasvī rakṣogaṇabalairvṛtaḥ।niryayāvudyatadhanuḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ ।। 6.96.32 ।।

translations.english: Then from the mighty chariot yoked to exceedingly swift horses, the mighty charioteer made his exit from the entrance and saw Rama and Lakshmana there.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रजवनाश्वेन रथेन स महारथः।द्वारेण निर्ययौ तेन यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.९६.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prajavanāśvena rathena sa mahārathaḥ।dvāreṇa niryayau tena yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.96.33 ।।

translations.english: Then the Sun lost his radiance, and the four directions were enveloped by gloom, the birds made fearful noise and the earth shook.

verses.sloka: ततो नष्टप्रभः सूर्यो दिशश्च तिमिरावृताः ।। ६.९६.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato naṣṭaprabhaḥ sūryo diśaśca timirāvṛtāḥ ।। 6.96.34 ।।

translations.english: Devas rained blood, horses stumbled, eagles settled on top of the post and jackals howled in a frightening way.

verses.sloka: द्विजाश्च नेदुर्घोराश्च सञ्चचालेव मेदिनी।ववर्ष रुधिरं देवश्चस्खलुस्तुरगाः पथि ।। ६.९६.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: dvijāśca nedurghorāśca sañcacāleva medinī।vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devaścaskhalusturagāḥ pathi ।। 6.96.35 ।।

translations.english: His left eye twitched, left arm quivered, face turned pale and indeed his tone became hoarse.

verses.sloka: ध्वजाग्रे न्यपतद्गृध्रो विनेदुश्चाशिवं शिवाः।नयनं चास्फुरद्वामं सव्यो बाहुरकम्पत ।। ६.९६.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhvajāgre nyapatadgṛdhro vineduścāśivaṁ śivāḥ।nayanaṁ cāsphuradvāmaṁ savyo bāhurakampata ।। 6.96.36 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter as Ravana set forth for the battle, all the following forms predicting his death appeared.

verses.sloka: विवर्णं वदनं चासीत् किञ्चिदभ्रश्यत स्वरः ।। ६.९६.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vivarṇaṁ vadanaṁ cāsīt kiñcidabhraśyata svaraḥ ।। 6.96.37 ।।

translations.english: A meteor had fallen from the sky resembling thunder, coupled with inauspicious eagle cries.

verses.sloka: ततो निष्पततो युद्धे दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः।रणे निधनशंसीनि रूपाण्येतानि जज्ञिरे ।। ६.९६.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato niṣpatato yuddhe daśagrīvasya rakṣasaḥ।raṇe nidhanaśaṁsīni rūpāṇyetāni jajñire ।। 6.96.38 ।।

translations.english: Impelled by the time spirit, Ravana set forth without thinking of the terrific portents that had appeared in delusion for his destruction.

verses.sloka: अन्तरिक्षात् पपातोल्का निर्घातसमनिस्वना।विनेदुरशिवा गृध्रा वायसैरनुनादिताः ।। ६.९६.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: antarikṣāt papātolkā nirghātasamanisvanā।vineduraśivā gṛdhrā vāyasairanunāditāḥ ।। 6.96.39 ।।

translations.english: The Vanaras stood facing the great sound of Rakshasa troops, on hearing the sounds of chariots for the sake of battle.

verses.sloka: एतानचिन्तयन् घोरानुत्पातान् समुपस्थितान्।निर्ययौ रावणो मोहाद्वधार्थी कालचोदितः ।। ६.९६.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: etānacintayan ghorānutpātān samupasthitān।niryayau rāvaṇo mohādvadhārthī kālacoditaḥ ।। 6.96.40 ।।

translations.english: Intense battle took place between the angry Vanaras and Rakshasas challenging one another desiring victory.

verses.sloka: तेषां तु रथघोषेण राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्।वानराणामपि चमूर्युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.९६.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tu rathaghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṁ mahātmanām।vānarāṇāmapi camūryuddhāyaivābhyavartata ।। 6.96.41 ।।

translations.english: There the tenheaded Ravana using arrows adorned with gold plumes struck Vanaras and a great war took place.

verses.sloka: तेषां तु तुमुलं युद्धं बभूव कपिरक्षसाम्।अन्योन्यमाह्वयानानां क्रुद्धानां जयमिच्छताम् ।। ६.९६.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tu tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ babhūva kapirakṣasām।anyonyamāhvayānānāṁ kruddhānāṁ jayamicchatām ।। 6.96.42 ।।

translations.english: Some Vanaras ' heads were deformed, some were pierced in their hearts, and some had their ears cut off.

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।वानराणामनीकेषु चकार कदनं महत् ।। ६.९६.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ।vānarāṇāmanīkeṣu cakāra kadanaṁ mahat ।। 6.96.43 ।।

translations.english: A few were made lifeless, some had their flanks split, some had their heads smashed and few were deprived of their eyes.

verses.sloka: निकृत्तशिरसः केचिद्रावणेन वलीमुखाः।केचिद्विच्छिन्न हृदयाः केचिच्छ्रोत्रविवर्जिताः।निरुच्छ्वासा हताः केचित् केचित् पार्श्वेषु दारिताः ।। ६.९६.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: nikṛttaśirasaḥ kecidrāvaṇena valīmukhāḥ।kecidvicchinna hṛdayāḥ kecicchrotravivarjitāḥ।nirucchvāsā hatāḥ kecit kecit pārśveṣu dāritāḥ ।। 6.96.44 ।।

translations.english: Devas rained blood, horses stumbled, eagles settled on top of the post and jackals howled in a frightening way.

verses.sloka: केचिद्विभिन्नशिरसः केचिच्चक्षुर्विवर्जिताः ।। ६.९६.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: kecidvibhinnaśirasaḥ keciccakṣurvivarjitāḥ ।। 6.96.45 ।।

translations.english: His left eye twitched, left arm quivered, face turned pale and indeed his tone became hoarse.

verses.sloka: दशाननः क्रोधविवृत्तनेत्रो यतो यतो ऽभ्येति रथेन सङ्ख्ये।ततस्ततस्तस्य शरप्रवेगं सोढुं न शेकुर्हरिपुङ्गवास्ते ।। ६.९६.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśānanaḥ krodhavivṛttanetro yato yato 'bhyeti rathena saṅkhye।tatastatastasya śarapravegaṁ soḍhuṁ na śekurharipuṅgavāste ।। 6.96.46 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter as Ravana set forth for the battle, all the following forms predicting his death appeared.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। ९६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ṣaṇṇavatitamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 96 ।।

translations.english: A meteor had fallen from the sky resembling thunder, coupled with inauspicious eagle cries.
